limits: Whole-cell byte shares do not measure simultaneous link load or queue causality
MoE and background finish windows differ; classes are not pooled
At least eight QPs per source/destination ToR is descriptive, not a significance threshold
Conditional source and destination HHI can coincide through deterministic path mapping; they are not independent measurements
Results reuse four revealed seeds and are not new efficacy samples

metrics_definition.conditional_destination: per destination ToR and source ToR, minimum eight QPs
metrics_definition.conditional_source: per source ToR and destination ToR, minimum eight QPs
metrics_definition.downward_port: penultimate switch sending into destination ToR
metrics_definition.hhi: sum of squared port byte shares; larger means more concentration
metrics_definition.total_destination: per destination ToR, combine all source ToRs within one class
metrics_definition.total_source: per source ToR, combine all destination ToRs within one class
metrics_definition.weight: observed data bytes at each hop, summed over entire cell
